"""
a = x ∘ w
                    b = x × w
                    c = x ⋅ w
                    where
                    x: ℤ ^ 3
                    w: ℤ ^ 3

import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, x, w):
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.int64)
        w = np.asarray(w, dtype=np.int64)
        assert x.shape == (3,)
        assert w.shape == (3,)
        # a = x ∘ w
        self.a = np.multiply(x, w)
        # b = x × w
        self.b = np.cross(x, w)
        # c = x ⋅ w
        self.c = np.dot((x).ravel(), (w).ravel())
